name: Tola
overview: Tola was a son of Issachar, noted in the genealogies of Genesis and Chronicles as a leader from this tribe whose descendants were recognized for their valor and strength. He is also identified as a judge of Israel who rose to defend the nation after Abimelech's death, judging Israel for twenty-three years and providing deliverance during a critical period. His residence in Shamir in Mount Ephraim and his leadership highlight God's provision of faithful judges to guide and save His people.
